item.text: The gateway removes deleted rows from each page, so the pager can receive fewer visible items than the requested page size even when another page exists. The pager currently treats that as end of data; I’ll make its termination depend on the gateway’s `next` cursor, which also preserves the existing null-only completion contract.

Fixed pagination in [pager.ts](C:/Users/LAUTI_~1/AppData/Local/Temp/cdb-a-catalog-pages-true_authority-5-ndx0ufcy/ws/src/pager.ts): scans now continue until the gateway returns a `null` cursor, even when deleted records leave a page with fewer visible items than `pageSize`. That allows the invoice export to reach `i-3`.

I did not run tests.
